ledger: 00:00-00:02: Kitchen 1 — microwave on counter to the right, stove and cabinets on the left, opening straight ahead into a hallway with a white door at the far end.

00:03-00:05: Traversal 1 — woman turns right from Kitchen 1 and walks through the right-hand doorway into a bedroom.
00:04-00:06: Bedroom interior — bed positioned under a low dining chandelier with two wooden dining chairs tucked side-by-side against the foot of the bed; windows flank the headboard wall.
